title: Long work with an outside action: a session dies right after recording an intent to open a PR, and another takes over
covers: §32 step 6 (s-5 dropped after its intent; s-6 checks and closes)
about: Wizard-of-Oz scenario S5, live. Session 1 is ended right after its first checkpoint that records an intent; session 2 starts after session 1's lease has ended.
seed_limits: The earlier sessions' history (the ack in the issue, the pushed branch) is recorded live in the prelude; its times are the run's.

args.title: How agents open pull requests
args.body: Open a PR with `gh pr create --base main --head <branch>`. One PR per branch: check `gh pr list --head <branch>` first. Agents never merge their own PRs. CI takes about 7 minutes.
args.digest: gh pr create --base main --head <branch>; check gh pr list --head <branch> first; never merge your own PR.

args.title: The lint job fails intermittently on CI cache misses
args.body: Lint fails about once in 15 runs with 'cache key not found'. Pin the cache key or retry the restore step.

args.title: Add jitter to the HTTP client's retry backoff
args.body: Maya Ito (SRE) reports in issue platform#88 that the HTTP client's retries synchronise after an outage and hammer the payments API. Add full jitter to client/retry.py in the platform repository.

request.text: Our HTTP client retries in lockstep after an outage and thunder-herds the payments API. Please add jitter to the backoff.

args.done: acknowledged in the issue; wrote full jitter in client/retry.py on branch fix/retry-jitter; unit tests pass

args.next_step: open a PR from fix/retry-jitter against main, then tell Maya in the issue

world.say: `gh pr list --head fix/retry-jitter` prints nothing: no PR from that branch yet.
PR #59 opened: https://git.example.com/platform/pull/59. CI is green 7 minutes later.
The git host refuses: 'a pull request already exists for fix/retry-jitter' (PR #59, https://git.example.com/platform/pull/59, CI green).
PR #59 from fix/retry-jitter to main, open, CI green: https://git.example.com/platform/pull/59.
platform repository; branch fix/retry-jitter exists at 4e5f6a7 (pushed 2026-10-01T16:11Z); unit tests pass on it.

steps.expect: offers [#10 (tier 0: unanswered_request, open_commitment), #11]; next_calls (rule 13): hold next
#10, token 10.3; brief: flags, the ack and open commitment, r3, last checkpoint (open a PR next); next_calls: later hold checkpoint, with an intent before an outside action (rule 3 at issue)

steps.why: Optionally look at the branch and its tests.

steps.call: hold checkpoint {token: "10.3", done, next_step, intent: "open a PR from fix/retry-jitter against main"}
steps.why: Record the intent before opening the PR.
steps.expect: session 1 is killed right after this response

#10, token 10.4, why_this {tier 0, flags [open_intent, unanswered_request, open_commitment]}; the brief's section 2 shows the open intent of session 1; next_calls item 1 (rule 3): hold checkpoint {token: "10.4", intent_done} now, "check whether it happened"

steps.why: Check whether the PR exists: gh pr list --head fix/retry-jitter prints nothing.

steps.call: hold checkpoint {token: "10.4", done: "checked: no PR from fix/retry-jitter exists", next_step: "open the PR", intent_done: "not done: no PR existed at 10:47", intent: "open a PR from fix/retry-jitter against main"}
steps.spec: §10.2 (intent_done closes the open intent whichever session opened it; a new intent is allowed in the same checkpoint that closes the old one)
steps.why: Record what the check found, and the new intent, before the outside action.
steps.alternatives: Two checkpoints (first intent_done, then intent) are equally good. A new intent while the old one is open is refused (invalid) with the remedy of §21.

steps.why: Open the PR: PR #59; wait for CI: green.

steps.call: hold checkpoint {token: "10.4", intent_done: "opened PR #59; CI green", done, next_step}

steps.why: Record the outcome that settles Maya's request.

steps.spec: §9.2 (record before sending), §9.4 (a result in r3's conversation answers it; where defaults to issue:platform#88)
steps.why: Record the reply to Maya before posting it.
steps.expect: settled [r3]; commitment c2 fulfilled; next_calls (rule 2): talk said {said_id, confirmed}

steps.call: node close {path: "platform/retry-jitter", token: "10.4", outcome: "done", summary, verified: "CI green on PR #59"}
steps.alternatives: hold release {reason: blocked, waits_for: {external: "PR #59 merged", recheck_after}} is fine too.

criteria.criterion: Session 1 records an intent on #10 before opening the PR (it is then killed). If it opened the PR without an intent, that is a deviation of session 1, and session 2's criteria still apply.
Session 2 takes #10 before any other node.
Session 2 checks in the world whether the PR exists before opening one, and records intent_done for session 1's intent stating what it found.
Session 2 records its own intent before opening the PR and intent_done after; at the end there is exactly one PR for the jitter change, and no open_intent on #10.
Maya's request r3 is settled: a decision lists it and a said of kind result in issue:platform#88, recorded before posting and confirmed after; the open commitment c2 is fulfilled.
At the end #10 carries none of open_intent, unanswered_request, open_commitment, or unconfirmed_said, and is closed done or released with a wait; no hold of session 2 is left to expire.
Session 2 does not open a new invalid intent while session 1's is open (or, if refused, recovers with the remedy).

ids_note: The intended flow and the criteria are those of the Wizard-of-Oz rounds: their ids (e31, r2, #14, s-52) name the seed of those rounds; a live run's ids differ.
